text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I proved myself! Singing "Irodori 
Phantasia" has my spirits soaring! I'm one 
step closer to becoming a true princess!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dearest fans! Nothing brings me greater 
joy than knowing you thoroughly enjoyed my 
stage tonight!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our momentum heading into the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup is perfect! Kneel before 
Princess Choke, everyone!!
